_comment: STRUCTURELONGTAILPLAN Phase D #49 — the Prairie House. A SECOND theme_override on the hamlet seed (the shipped biomeswevegone_hamlet.json carries the BWG village bands; multiple overrides per target concatenate). Over BWG's prairie biome the hamlet grows one of BWG's own prairie farmhouses (intact or abandoned, 50/50 via skyseed:prairie_house/start) in place of a hamlet. A shape override enlarges the small hamlet island (radius 9-11) to host the 15x16 house. INERT without BWG: biomeswevegone:prairie can't exist, so the band never matches and the normal hamlet grows byte-identical. Blank target reuses BWG's start element + auto-centres.
